t.zh: 现在可以买卖很多次，但卖掉的第二天不能买：要歇一天。
t.en: Now you may trade as often as you like, but not buy on the day after you sell: you have to rest a day.

t.zh: 状态还是三种：空手、手里有股、刚卖掉。「刚卖掉」过一天就回到「空手」，这一步的进账是 0。
t.en: There are still three states: empty-handed, holding, just sold. “Just sold” turns back into “empty-handed” a day later, and that step brings in 0.

goal.en: Work out the most money you can make.

how.zh: 层和层怎么接，世界已经接好了。你的电路板要改吗？
how.en: How the layers connect is set by the world. Does your board need to change?

body.zh: 电路板一点没变，变的只是层和层怎么接：「刚卖掉」走回「空手」，那一步就是歇着的那一天。
body.en: The board didn’t change at all; only how the layers connect did. Stepping from “just sold” back to “empty-handed” is the day of rest.

body.zh: <level-ref to="stock1"></level-ref>是这一关剪掉一根箭头：卖掉了，就回不去了。
body.en: <level-ref to="stock1"></level-ref> is this one with an arrow cut: once sold, there is no going back.
